blocks.text: Paanch d orbitals dxy, dxz, dyz, dx2-y2 aur dz2 hain. Chaar ki shakal teen patti (aik plane mein chaar lobes) aur dz2 ke do lobes aur aik challa hai. Akele atom mein paanchon ki tawanai barabar hai: yeh degenerate hain. In ki shakalein aur simtein transition metals ki bonding, rang aur magnetic khasiyatein tay karti hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch 3d orbitals apne axes ke saath: dxy, dyz aur dxz ke chaar lobes axes ke darmiyan; dx2-y2 ke chaar lobes x aur y axes par; dz2 ke do lobes z axis par aur beech mein aik challa (ring). Do rang lobes ke mukhtalif sign dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Paanch 3d orbitals ki shakalein (is topic ke liye asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naranji aur neela rang wave function ke musbat aur manfi sign (phase) hain. dxy, dyz aur dxz ke lobes axes ke beech, jab ke dx2-y2 ke lobes seedhe axes par hain; isi liye octahedral complex mein ligands (jo axes par aate hain) dx2-y2 aur dz2 ko zyada dhakelte hain aur yeh oopar chale jate hain.

blocks.title: Degenerate aur non-degenerate orbitals
blocks.text: Degenerate orbitals ki tawanai barabar hoti hai. Jab ligands complex banane ke liye dhaat ke ion ke qareeb aate hain to un ka electric field paanch d orbitals ko mukhtalif tawanai ke do sets mein baant deta hai (non-degenerate). Dono sets ka tawanai ka farq delta E likha jata hai.
Octahedral complex (chhe ligands), jaise [Ti(H2O)6]3+, mein d orbitals teen kam tawanai wale (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do zyada tawanai wale (dx2-y2, dz2) orbitals mein bat jate hain.

blocks.alt: Tawanai (energy) ka diagram, Energy ka teer oopar. Degenerate Orbitals: paanch barabar dabbe dxy, dyz, dzx, dx2-y2, dz2, aik electron ke saath. Ligands interaction: paanchon dabbe oopar uthe hue. Phir batwara: dx2-y2 aur dz2 oopar, dxy, dyz aur dzx neeche electron ke saath, darmiyan Delta E. Light jazb hoti hai aur Excitation ke baad electron oopar wale set mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.4: Octahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (kitab ki Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh [Ti(H2O)6]3+ jaisa d1 ion hai, jis ka sirf aik d electron hai. Ligands ke aane se paanchon orbitals ki tawanai barhti hai, phir woh do sets mein bat jate hain: teen neeche (t2g) aur do oopar (eg). Roshni ka aik hissa jazb ho kar electron ko neeche se oopar bhejta hai; jazb roshni ki tawanai Delta E = h nu ke barabar hai.

Tetrahedral complex (chaar ligands), jaise [CuCl4]2-, mein splitting ulat jati hai: teen zyada tawanai wale (dxy, dxz, dyz) aur do kam tawanai wale (dx2-y2, dz2) orbitals. Splitting octahedral complexes se kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Nau d electrons ka tawanai diagram. Degenerate orbitals: paanch barabar dabbe, chaar mein jore aur aik mein akela electron. Ligands interaction: dabbe oopar uthe hue. Batwara: dxy, dyz, dzx oopar (jora, jora, akela) aur dx2-y2, dz2 neeche (dono jore), darmiyan Delta E. Light jazb hoti hai aur Excitation ke baad oopar ka set poora aur neeche aik akela electron.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.5: Tetrahedral field mein d orbitals ki splitting (kitab ki Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh [CuCl4]2- jaisa d9 ion hai. Tetrahedral mein tarteeb ulat jati hai: do orbitals neeche aur teen oopar, aur Delta E octahedral se chhota hota hai. Roshni neeche wale set ka aik electron oopar ke khaali jagah wale orbital mein bhejti hai.

blocks.prompt: Octahedral complex mein kaun se d orbitals zyada tawanai par hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: dx2-y2 aur dz2, kyunke un ke lobes axes par maujood ligands ki seedh mein hain aur sab se zyada dhakelay jate hain.

items: Azad ion mein paanch d orbitals degenerate; ligands unhein delta E se baant'te.
Octahedral: 3 neeche, 2 oopar. Tetrahedral: 2 neeche, 3 oopar, chhota farq.
